reason: Test whether the most generalizable component of RC8—taxonomic deepening within already-active sampling units—shows the same rainfall-associated direction in independent North American and Australian monitoring systems.
authorized_new_endpoint_family: Australian FrogID continuous taxonomic depth within already-active recordings, using the already frozen FrogID sample and timezone-repaired ERA5 dry-spell exposure.
Cross-system directional comparison against the already authorized NAAMP local-alpha result among active stops.
not_authorized: replacement of the RC8 North American matrix-geometry test

promotion_rule.cross_continental_consistency: Authorized only if the Australian primary continuous-depth coefficient is negative with its complete 95% CI below zero, while the already frozen NAAMP active-alpha coefficient remains positive with its complete 95% CI above zero.
promotion_rule.strong_cross_continental_consistency: Additionally requires the Australian recorder-clustered and within-ERA5-cell continuous-depth sensitivities to have negative coefficients with complete 95% CIs below zero.
promotion_rule.failure: If the Australian primary gate fails, retain FrogID as a historical differently conditioned contrast and do not add cross-continental generality to the RC8 headline.

wording_boundary: Even a strong pass authorizes cross-continental consistency across independent North American and Australian monitoring systems, not a world-wide or universal response.
